tips.text: Check the Invasions list every session and jump on a Twin Vipers Wraith part when it appears; there is no schedule.
Do all three missions in one sitting so the Invasion cannot end on you.
Expect a part on a node with a running Invasion to wait behind it; the new one starts only when the first ends.
Play one side repeatedly to push a dragging Invasion to 100% and end it.
Treat it as an RNG wait, not a grind; nothing speeds up the spawn.
